text:
maya: Heads-up — Ember-7B rollout. On a subset of cold-start requests we're seeing repeated initial tokens and sometimes the prompt control marker leaking into output. Quick repro below, seen on q4_k and fp16 variants.

maya: repro (minimal):
```
prompt = "INSTR: Translate to French:\nHello."
// model output (observed):
"INSTR: Translate to French:\nHello. Hello. Hello..."
```

maya: batch size=1, kv-cache warm=false for the tests. First-token latency also spikes ~200-400ms on handful of nodes.

dmitri: thanks. which quant profile + inference engine variant? q4_k on fused-attn or vanilla?

maya: q4_k on fused-attn runtime (v2.3.1). Also repros on fp16 runtime but less frequently.

ops-bot: deploy: Ember-7B v2026-03-18 rolled to canary pool at 2026-03-18T21:12Z. No config changes since that deploy.

alice: can you dump tokenizer outputs for the prompt? sounds like tokenization boundary or prefix-cache mismatch. also try float32 baseline on the same node.

maya: attaching token ids (copied): [101, 2003, 345, ...] — will paste full in a sec. float32 baseline reproduced once (less repetitiveness) but still weird for the exact same node.

ben: I'll run the eval harness against the canonical prompt set (1000 examples) on both q4_k and fp16 and compare n-gram repetition and perplexity. ETA 2h.

ryan: also check kernel-selection logs and kv-cache evictions. if the runtime chooses a different kernel path on cold-start that might cause off-by-one in cache pointers.

maya: noted. quick checklist I'm starting:
- reproduce minimal locally (done)
- collect tokenizer ids + model logits for first 10 steps (in progress)
- run float32 vs q4_k batch=1 comparison (ben)
- fetch node runtime logs: kernel selection + kvcache traces (ryan)
- smoke test with kv-cache forced-on vs forced-off (maya)
- run eval harness for 1k prompts (ben)

dmitri: add: run with debug-attn to capture attention weights for first 8 tokens — looking for attention collapse to first token.

maya: added. assigning owners: ben (evals), ryan (runtime logs), dmitri (attention debug), maya (repro + kv-cache tests). ping @eng-runtime if memory view needed.

ryan: I see a pattern in the canary logs — a subset of nodes had an old nvrtc kernel fallback after driver restart. collecting trace. could be correlated.

alice: if that's true, we should rollback canary nodes with fallback kernel to the stable kernel and re-run repro. ops, can you isolate those nodes?

ops-bot: flagged nodes: gpu-canary-12, gpu-canary-19. marking for isolation. :white_check_mark:

maya: rolling repro on isolated nodes now. if rollback fixes it we can pause rollout.

ben: eval run (q4_k vs fp16) done: q4_k has 2.6% higher initial-token repetition rate on the prompt set; aggregate perplexity up ~4%. uploading artifacts to /mnt/evals/ember7b/2026-03-18.

dmitri: thanks. next steps: if kernel fallback is root cause, coordinate with runtime to force kernel selection and rerun q4_k tests. if not, dig into quantization hooks for prefix handling.

maya: good plan. keeping this channel for quick updates — will post repro logs and exact token ids in a follow-up message. :thumbsup:

ryan: provisional action: pause further Ember-7B canary expansion until kernel-selection fix validated. filing a short blip on the rollout dashboard.

maya: ack. I'll update product/ops. Closing loop once we have deterministic repro or rollback confirmation.
